description: This file implements the OLLamaLLMService class, which extends the OpenAILLMService to provide support for locally hosted OLLama models within the Pipecat AI framework. It includes methods to initialize the service with specific model parameters and to create an API client compatible with OpenAI.

classes.name: OLLamaLLMService
classes.description: A service class extending OpenAILLMService to support OLLama models locally, providing an interface compatible with OpenAI APIs.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, model: str = "llama2", base_url: str = "http://localhost:11434/v1", **kwargs )
methods.description: Initializes the OLLamaLLMService with default or provided model and base URL, passing them along with an API key to the parent class.

methods.name: create_client(self, base_url=None, **kwargs)
methods.description: Creates an API client configured for OLLama, optionally based on a provided base URL, by calling the parent class's create_client method.
